sources.title: ViTMatte: Boosting Image Matting with Pretrained Plain Vision Transformers
sources.depth: Full HTML paper opened and read through methodology, training, experiments, and benchmark discussion.
sources.finding: Uses a pretrained plain vision transformer with hybrid window/global attention, convolution necks, and a lightweight detail-capture stream. The method takes an RGB image plus a trimap and predicts alpha; benchmark evaluation includes Composition-1k and Distinctions-646.
sources.limitation: Research benchmark results do not prove performance on small DTF lettering, distressed art, or customer uploads; trimap is an input.

sources.title: Fast Multi-Level Foreground Estimation
sources.depth: Full HTML paper opened and read through method, qualitative/quantitative experiments, runtime, memory, and conclusion.
sources.finding: Separates foreground-color estimation from alpha estimation. A multi-level method propagates foreground/background color estimates into translucent regions and reduces background-color bleed; the paper reports SAD, MSE, gradient error, runtime, and memory.
sources.limitation: The authors' benchmarks use matting datasets and do not directly measure print quality; results depend on the alpha matte and color-space handling.

sources.title: Восстановление расфокусированных и смазанных изображений
sources.depth: Full visible article opened; read degradation model, PSF discussion, noise-aware deconvolution, MATLAB examples, and artifact discussion.
sources.finding: Models blur as convolution with a point-spread function plus noise, and compares Wiener, Tikhonov-regularized, blind, and Richardson–Lucy restoration examples. The article shows that noise can dominate naive inverse filtering.
sources.limitation: Educational 2012 article with illustrative MATLAB examples; parameters and boundary handling require modern validation.

sources.title: Восстановление расфокусированных и смазанных изображений. Практика
sources.depth: Full visible article opened; read practical deconvolution discussion, frequency-domain formulation, examples, and real-image caveats.
sources.finding: Demonstrates how PSF choice, noise estimates, and iterative restoration affect practical results. Restored images can become more legible while acquiring artifacts.
sources.limitation: The article's camera examples and hand-selected parameters are not a controlled DTF artwork benchmark.

sources.title: Восстановление расфокусированных и смазанных изображений. Повышаем качество
sources.depth: Full visible article opened; read total-variation prior, edge-preservation rationale, smoothed objective, and iterative optimization discussion.
sources.finding: Total-variation regularization is presented as a way to reduce ringing and preserve sharper boundaries compared with basic Wiener restoration. The author explicitly notes that restoration generally does not create genuinely new source detail.
sources.limitation: TV restoration can still alter fine texture and needs tuning; this is not evidence that aggressive sharpening improves printability.

sources.title: Метод повышения резкости цифровых изображений
sources.depth: Repository record and abstract read; PDF was not available/read.
sources.finding: The abstract describes multiscale differential-response analysis and a reconstruction function for sharpening, with gradient-sign handling near object boundaries and integer arithmetic to reduce computation. It targets mild blur without requiring a known blur kernel.
sources.limitation: Abstract-level evidence only; no independent reproduction or DTF test.

sources.title: Transparency Flattener preset options in InDesign
sources.depth: Official documentation page opened and read, including resolution, outline, clipping, and preview-option descriptions.
sources.finding: Transparency flattening balances raster and vector regions. Adobe describes 600–1200 ppi for high-quality line art/text rasterization and typically 150–300 ppi for gradients/meshes; outlining strokes can slightly thicken them, and clipping complex regions may reduce stitching artifacts.
sources.limitation: Applies to formats/workflows that require transparency flattening; these settings are not a universal specification for transparent PNG DTF masters.

sources.title: Guida alla preparazione del file di stampa
sources.depth: Full visible print-preparation guidance page opened and read.
sources.finding: The printer specifies its own file requirements for resolution, accepted formats, CMYK conversion, transparency effects, outlined/embedded fonts, bleed, and safety margins. It is a concrete example of printer-specific preflight rules.
sources.limitation: Conventional commercial-print guidance, not DTF-specific. Its 300-DPI and CMYK requirements must not be treated as universal rules for transparent DTF PNGs.

sources.title: Blind Deconvolution — автоматическое восстановление смазанных изображений
sources.depth: Full visible article opened and read, including image/kernel model, objective priors, pyramid refinement, implementation notes, and limits.
sources.finding: Blind deconvolution jointly estimates the latent image and blur kernel, using priors on image gradients and kernel structure. A coarse-to-fine image pyramid refines the kernel across scales; the article notes substantial memory cost and imperfect robustness.
sources.limitation: Historical implementation notes include small image-size limits and acknowledge that acceptable results are not achieved for every image.

sources.title: Context-Aware Image Matting for Simultaneous Foreground and Alpha Estimation — inference implementation README
sources.depth: Repository README opened and read, including requirements, run commands, model variants, and license statement.
sources.finding: The implementation accepts an image and trimap and estimates both alpha and foreground color. The README documents legacy TensorFlow versions and substantial RAM/GPU needs, and offers smaller-input/CPU fallbacks.
sources.limitation: The README states the provided implementation is for research purposes and directs commercial users to contact the authors. Do not incorporate into a commercial product without resolving licensing/permission.
